title: Incomplete beta has no basym arm, reflects bfrac prefactors above 0.99 using caller y, and unifies bup and bgrat
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, the incomplete-beta routine (bratio) removes TOMS 708's bratio_basym arm: all min(a0, b0) > 1.0, b0 >= 40.0 inputs stay on bratio_bfrac continuously across b = 100 and lambda = 0.03 * b (checked across 22 live bisection points). Inside bratio_bfrac, when x > 0.99 (0x3fefae147ae147ae, strict >), Excel evaluates the density prefactor as excel_brcomp(b, a, y, x) using the caller's stored complement y rather than 1.0 - x (eliminating 53-bit cancellation in F.DIST.RT, FDIST, and F.DIST), while keeping lam = |a - (a + b) * x| on x. bratio_bup runs Excel's density-based stored-power recurrence for all n >= 2 (including bup_140's n = 20 shift), using ((x * y) / a) * density with stored exp(m * ln(x)) and binary64 summation for b > 1.0, and extended-precision x^m and summation for b <= 1.0 (plus excel_log(y) in beta_density_at for a < 1 || b < 1, x > 0.99). bratio_bgrat applies the 0.99 lnx switch to all b, evaluates seeded b == 0.5 via erf/erfc, b == 1.0 via exp(-z), and z >= 1.1 via excel_gamma_fraction(b, z).
basis: Measured across cb5 (1,638 live Excel 16.0.20527 calls; frozen_cb5_f_gt099_v2.jsonl 59 of 100 vs 0 of 100, 99 of 100 within 5 ULP) and nx4 (frozen_nx4_predictions.jsonl 115 of 360 vs 34 of 360). Landing nx4 moved 29 beta-family witness banks (168,767 rows) from 166,630 to 167,126 (+496 net, 0 full regressions: FDIST +206, BETA.DIST +116, BETADIST +24, CONFIDENCE.T 4,282/4,282, FINV pinned 32/32).
inferred: That Excel executes these branch rules and intermediate store sites is inferred from continuity probes, frozen holdouts, and witness-bank improvements; inner-loop rounding in bfrac and non-half bgrat remain open.
